title.en: A-B Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion

chapters.summary: Detailed description of acupuncture points and their functions

sections.title: Acupoints Chapter One
sections.originalText: 腧穴者，经络之所会，气血之所行。知其所在，明其功能，则针到病除。
sections.translation: Acupoints are where meridians meet, where qi and blood flow. Knowing their locations and understanding their functions, needles arrive and illness is removed.
sections.interpretation: This chapter explains the fundamental concept of acupoints as the intersection points of meridians and the flow of qi and blood.

chapters.summary: Comprehensive study of acupuncture points and techniques

sections.title: Acupuncture Study Chapter One
sections.originalText: 凡刺之法，必先明经络，知穴道，然后可施针。不知经络，不知穴道，妄施针石，伤人肌肤。
sections.translation: All acupuncture methods must first understand the meridians, know the acupoint pathways, then apply needles. Without understanding meridians and acupoint pathways, blindly applying needles and stones injures people's skin and flesh.
sections.interpretation: This chapter emphasizes the importance of understanding meridian theory and acupoint locations before practicing acupuncture.

clinicalApplications: Reference for acupoint location and function
